sections.title: Part 1
sections.instructions: You should spend about 20 minutes on this task. Write at least 150 words.

questions.title: The chart below shows the percentage of Bangladeshi students of different ages who attended HEXA’S daily from 2021 to 2023.
questions.question: Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.

sections.title: Part 2
sections.instructions: You should spend about 40 minutes on this task. Write at least 250 words.

questions.title: In the last decade, there has been a great increase in global air travel. What do you think are the reasons for this and do you think it is a good thing?
questions.question: Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.
